root_cause: Netlify entrepreneur intelligence proxy waited without a fetch deadline while EU Edge/PostgREST were overloaded, yielding downstream HTTP 504. Shared JSON helper gave error responses 60s private cache and 240s stale-while-revalidate.
intervention: Bound only entrepreneur_intelligence upstream fetch to 23s with AbortController plus hard deadline; fail closed with 503 and Retry-After 20. Cache-Control no-store for all auth/error responses. Preserve success cache, tenant validation, service token and other gateway actions.
prevention: Do not cache 4xx/5xx as tenant truth or leave Netlify running upstream until platform timeout. Never synthesize success from incomplete data.
